why: Mana pass on responses-v3 (2026-09-11): blue 16 and black 11 short of Karsten targets (Marang UU, Crux BB), two logged losses to colours. Six lands whose ablation on mana-analysis is neutral or better in EVERY colour out, six fetchlands in: with seven shocks and three battle lands each fetch is an untapped five-colour source. The basics stay, because Prismatic Vista and Fabled Passage fetch basics only and cutting the last Island cost them blue (measured: Island -> Delta read U -2). The goldfish cannot rank lands; mana-analysis is the evidence, and this objective (two dead turns in a row, 0.078) is the one goldfish row a colour screw shows in.
